question: State the law of diminishing marginal utility and explain its assumptions and exceptions.

points.label: Statement of the law
points.description: As a consumer consumes more units of a commodity, the marginal utility from each successive unit diminishes.

points.label: Total and marginal utility
points.description: Total utility increases at a diminishing rate, is maximum when marginal utility is zero, and falls when marginal utility becomes negative.

points.label: Assumptions about units
points.description: Units are homogeneous and of reasonable size, and consumption is continuous without a long time gap.

points.label: Assumptions about the consumer
points.description: The consumer is rational and their tastes, income and preferences remain unchanged.

points.label: Exceptions
points.description: Exceptions or limitations include hobbies and collections, rare goods, money, and addictive goods.
